reviews.text:
Perfect habit tracking app. Perfect app for tracking my health goals like drinking more water, running, and meditation. I also use it for little self care routines like affirmations. 

I look forward to getting my streaks each day and I've progressed a lot more using this app than when I was just trying to remember to do anything. Meditating 20 min twice a day is part of my routine now whereas it used to be a struggle getting a few times per week. Life is busy and having a tool to help you stay organized is super important if you want to better yourself and reach your goals. We all have goals but sometimes years go by without making any progress - this app is the perfect antidote to that. 

It's also crazy when you actually start recording how much you do, you see how many days you've been skipping without even really realizing it. Once I saw that it really clicked and this app has been a great motivator.

I would definitely recommend this app to anyone who is trying to build healthy habits or who has long term goals they're trying to reach. I would even say it's essential! The app does a fantastic job of organizing your tasks and keeping track of what to do, and it's easy to use. It looks like some analytic functions are coming soon which I am excited for. The app has worked great for me so if you're wondering if you should try it, you should.

reviews.text:
Nice Design. So far the app is really simple to use. For streaks related to health (steps and workouts) stuff like that, it would be nice if the app could read from Apple Health so it can automatically complete your streak based off that data. 

Would also be nice if there was an Apple Watch app for this allowing you to quickly view your day’s goals all from the watch screen.

Overall I’m not getting attached to this app since it’s mentioning “pro features” coming. Which tells me the pro features are going to have a lot of these really useful functions. If the pro features turns out to be a monthly or yearly subscription, I’m walking. I would be more than happy to pay a one time reasonable fee but not jumping on another monthly subscription. 

Holding out till more fixes and features come and I’ll adjust my review at that time.

reviews.text:
Great Start! Has Potential. This app just came out & there are a lot of features “coming soon”. I’ll update my review over time, but so far:

PROS:
- Visually pleasing layout 
- User interface is easy to navigate 
- Intuitive design 
- Ability to rename each habit 
- Reminders work nicely 
- Encourages me to keep coming back to the app 

CONS:
- Can’t swipe left to undo like instructed (maybe coming soon?)
- The frequency selections aren’t always what I want… sometimes “x TIMES per x” doesn’t exist as an option & have to select a different unit of measurement… makes customization a little clunky there.
- When selecting “weekly” or “monthly”, the app automatically applies the habit to reoccur on the current day. I wanted to select a habit to be every Sunday but had to back out & go to Sunday to add it OR select “daily” then deselect all other days. It’s not awful, but would be nice to be able to select which day from that spot on the app when selecting weekly or monthly.
- Can’t view the calendar as a whole month to select days, can only swipe through the week (maybe have to add more data?)

SUGGESTION:
- put a number on the app icon (like how apps show # of notifications) to let me know how many habits I still need to complete for the day

Overall, I’m enjoying it so far & can’t wait to see what comes next!!
